artifacts.summary: Locates the excursion predicate, confirms $TASK_DIR is already archive-aware and sufficient, recommends whole-directory exemption via a repo-relative implicit file_scope member, finds an unrelated absolute-path counter-example in modified_files that argues for staying advisory now with a recorded promotion criterion, and scopes the task-270 cross-reference repair as a specs/** metadata edit.

memory_candidates.content: orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's WORK (h) excursion check reads $TASK_DIR (already archive-aware via task_lookup_dir() in scripts/lib/task-lookup-lib.sh, threaded through the single shared skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md call site for both engines) -- any postflight fix needing 'the task directory the dispatch actually used' should read $TASK_DIR rather than re-deriving active-vs-archive resolution.

modified_files is schema-mandated repo-relative-only (return-metadata-file.md), but at least one live .return-meta.json (task 299) holds absolute paths, and validate-return-meta.sh has no check for modified_files path form. This is a live, unvalidated gap worth a dedicated lint task.
